title: Native one-source closure on the R2-10 source: lazy per-schema caller-compiled output validators (HCL), the admission tools-list cache (V), session amortization; and the R2-09 X11 ax_fg unguarded DoAction route
base: 85a73c2c71e44ca512b8cc6023cf5c77c0f35bdc = R2-10 source 8f3a646b4818b757648835cf89db8886626b1cf0 + a cherry-pick of N-02 194a6342e21b74f37f4e23af1d90bf32ad377397 (MCP span marks + CUA_DRIVER_EXP_FOCUS_GUARD_CLAMP knob, both default off; proxy::run_direct conflict resolved as a union). git range-diff 194a6342e^..194a6342e vs 85a73c2c7^..85a73c2c7: only the commit message and conflict context differ (raw/provenance/range-diff.txt).
tested_source: 85a73c2c71e44ca512b8cc6023cf5c77c0f35bdc (libs/cua-driver unchanged by this branch: no Driver change in attempt 2)

N3.build: build-driver.sh under hostless + cargo-build lock, target dir family cua-release-r2-10, cargo build --locked --release -p cua-driver --features portal-input
N3.role: the ONLY binary in every Part A and Part B arm and in every control except the R side of the default-off smoke

R.role: default-off smoke comparator only (tools/list identity, receipt shapes); never ratioed against

attempt1_N3.note: attempt-1 build of the same source; NOT used. The attempt-2 rebuild is not bit-identical (size +96 bytes; the differing strings are LLVM anonymous-symbol hashes); no measured trial ever used the attempt-1 binary

attempt1_disclosure: Attempt 1 (branch exp/n-03-native-closure-axfg-20261003, worktree w4-n03-native-closure) aborted before PREREG and before any measured trial. Its SHARED pilots n03p-ap1, n03p-ap2, n03p-bp1..bp5 and n03p-bp1-r1 (n03p-bp1 failed to open the private DISPLAY) are EXCLUDED from every analysis. Its uncommitted harness (n03_harness.py, fixture_axfg.py, make_plan.py, run_all.sh, run_block.sh, xprobe.py) was reviewed and copied; the only harness change is two session timestamps (session_start_m, session_tasks_end_m). plan.json regenerated by make_plan.py is byte-identical to attempt 1's (sha256 ac905ab3...).

provider.name: TypeSafe
provider.note: no provider in any arm; the harness refuses every non-loopback TCP connect and counts refusals

isolation: every code-executing command under bin/hostless; native blocks under hostless + hostless-strict + cua-x11-session.sh (private Xvfb, private AT-SPI bus: CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1, CUA_SESSION_EXTRA_ENV carries CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1 CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 DO_NOT_TRACK=1); TMPDIR = lane tmp dir
locks: measured blocks: cargo-build lock taken FIRST, then bin/quiet-timed (EXCLUSIVE quiet-lane lock, receipt line in the shared quiet-lane ledger), each block < 25 min; controls and pilots: flock -s on the quiet-lane lock with an own receipt line (lane, label, mode shared, pid, acquired, released, rc, loadavg_at_acquire) in the shared ledger and in raw/

step0_pilot_facts.class: REAL (pilot, SHARED lock, EXCLUDED from analysis; labels n03a2p-ap1, ap2, bp1, bp2, bp3, bp4, bp5)
step0_pilot_facts.part_a: 12/12 + 2/2 decoy trials verified on N3; every action receipt route accessibility, delivery background; MCP span marks present; V arms show mcp.inner_validation_skipped; HCL arms compile each tool's validator at its first call (setup tools outside T, get_window_state/set_value/click inside T); library re-check agreed on 5/5, 6/6, 18/18 lazily validated calls. Library validation costs about 6-16 ms per call at loadavg 12-18; a compiled validator's per-call iteration about 0.1-1 ms (k=5 session tasks 1-4).
step0_pilot_facts.part_b_route: fixture_axfg.py (CUA_N03_AXFG=1): the scrolled-out 'Hidden agree' check box and 'Hidden save' button, clicked by element_token with delivery_mode foreground, take ForegroundElementPlacement::NoPoint (not showing) in decide_foreground_element_placement (platform-linux tools/impl_.rs) and fire perform_action_observed with the window activated: receipt route accessibility, delivery mode foreground, text 'path=ax_fg', atspi_action/do_action_replied mark present, 18/18 pilot rows; 0 global_input rows.
step0_pilot_facts.part_b_guard: At the default configuration the X11 foreground wrapper (input/foreground.rs wait_for_window_change, CUA_DRIVER_WINDOW_CHANGE_TIMEOUT_MS default 800 ms on X11) polls the window set after the action body: DoAction reply -> tool return was 821-888 ms in B and S0 (pilot bp1, bp5). The post-DoAction sleep is therefore NOT the only post-action wait on ax_fg at default. With the documented embedding-host setting CUA_DRIVER_WINDOW_CHANGE_TIMEOUT_MS=0 (EMBEDDING.md; the set is read once, no polling) the post-DoAction sleep is the only post-action wait: DoAction reply -> return 10.7-11.3 ms in S0U, 60.5-63.6 ms in BU (pilot bp4).
step0_pilot_facts.positive_control_pilot: 30 ms app-side delay: S0U not visible at return 2/2 (margins -16.1, -203.7 ms); BU 1/2 visible (the GLib timeout fired 95 ms late once at loadavg ~14); S0 at default visible 2/2 (the 800 ms observation covers it).

part_a.tasks: canonical GTK3 fixture (libs/cua-driver/tests/fixtures/apps/linux/gtk3/main.py), the R2-04 tasks: checkbox = get_window_state -> scripted lookup 'I agree' (jev-use NativeObservation + eligible_controls, unique exact label) -> click(element_token, delivery_mode background); text = get_window_state -> lookup 'Note', 'Save note' -> set_value(Note, per-task token) -> click(Save note, background)

arms.X: R2-10's native composed arm: CUA_DRIVER_EXP_NATIVE_POST_ACTION_SLEEP_MS=0 + set_agent_cursor_motion {glide_duration_ms: 1}; library output validation (mcp ClientSession._validate_tool_result -> jsonschema.validate every call)
arms.X+HCL: X with caller-compiled output validators compiled LAZILY per schema at that schema's first use, inside the call that needs it (so inside T for the in-T tools); acceptance rule identical to jsonschema.validate (validator_for + check_schema + cls(schema, registry=Registry()); best_match over iter_errors); a re-listed schema object is recompiled
arms.X+V: X with CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ADMISSION_TOOLS_CACHE=1 (B-02 knob already in R: direct-stdio admission validates a tools/call once against the adapter's process-lifetime inventory by reference; the inner boundary skips its second validation for the same era)

design.k1_primary: 4x4 Williams square (rows [0,1,3,2] rotated; first-order carry-over balanced); 24 rounds per task; each round runs both tasks (first task alternates) and per task the 4 arms in Williams row (round mod 4); one fresh Driver + one fresh fixture per trial (as R2-10); blocks a1 (rounds 0-11) and a2 (rounds 12-23), 96 trials each. 24 within-round pairs per contrast per task.
design.k5_secondary: 5 tasks per Driver session and fixture; 12 sessions per arm per task (rounds 0-11, Williams row (round+1) mod 4); blocks k1 (rounds 0-5) and k2 (6-11), 48 sessions each. Reported: per-task T (first-use compile inside task 0's T) and the session total.
design.block_order: a1, k1, b1, a2, k2, bu1 (measured, EXCLUSIVE); then controls (SHARED)

part_a.oracle: CUA_GTK3_TASK_STATE file, a fresh path per trial, written by the fixture app (atomic replace), read every 2 ms by an independent harness thread; verified iff the first sample starting at/after the last action's return shows the expected state AND the final state has seq == before.seq + 1 (exactly one mutation).
part_a.T: T_oracle = caller monotonic time from the first observation's send (T0) to the read-end of the first oracle sample at/after the last action's return that shows the expected state (R2-10 / N-01R definition).
part_a.route_validity: every action receipt route accessibility; the full R2-04 mark sequence in order (click: element_resolved, placement_done, reveal_done, ax_start, focus_guard captured, atspi_action connected, live_checked, metadata_done, do_action_replied, post_sleep_done, focus_guard body_done, restored, ax_joined; set_value: element_resolved, cursor_done, write_done, readback_done); dispatch_enter/exit marks; MCP span marks request_read <= parse_done <= handler_start <= handler_end <= serialize_done <= response_written per call; client stamps present; exp_knob marks == {post_action_sleep_ms=0}; cursor glide 1 and enabled; V arms: every tools/call in T shows mcp.inner_validation_skipped and non-V arms never do; HCL arms: compile stamps for get_window_state and each action tool inside their own call windows in task 0 and none later in the session, non-HCL arms none. A trial failing any check is invalid; invalid and unverified trials stay in every denominator.
part_a.components: R2-10 native components (observation_transport, observation, runner, resolution, reveal, dispatch, post_action_sleep, settle, result, action_transport, effect_lag, verification_read) with R2-10's boundaries. Each call's transport (m0 -> dispatch_enter, dispatch_exit -> m1) is split with the N-02 span marks into client_build, client_write_pipe, drv_parse, drv_admission, drv_inner_pre, drv_inner_post, drv_bookkeep_serialize, drv_write, client_pipe_read_parse, client_result_model, client_validate, client_return (N-02 names and boundaries). The V-targeted work is admission_v = (mcp.session_validated -> mcp.admission_validated) + (mcp.inner_classified -> mcp.inner_validated), carved out of drv_admission and drv_inner_pre. Spec buckets: Driver serialize/write = drv_bookkeep_serialize + drv_write (+ drv_inner_post reported separately), pipe + client read/parse = client_write_pipe + client_pipe_read_parse + client_result_model (the kernel pipe is not isolated from the Python reader/writer), validation = client_validate.

gates.statistics: paired within-round differences (arm A minus arm B), median and seeded percentile bootstrap 95% CI over pairs (10000 resamples, seed 20261003); medians; nearest-rank p95; loadavg per trial; every trial kept

HCL.primary_metric: k=1 net saving = paired T_oracle(X) - T_oracle(X+HCL), per task, first-use compile inside T
HCL.DELETED_KEEP: median >= 5 ms AND CI lower bound > 0 AND online equivalence 100% (every lazily validated call's verdict equals the library's) AND the offline corpus passes (10 injected invalid outputs per tool rejected by both paths; real outputs accepted by both) AND validity 100% (every HCL-arm main and session trial valid and verified)
HCL.OWNER_DECISION: not DELETED at k=1, but the k=5 net saving (paired session total sum of the 5 task T's, X - X+HCL) has median > 0 with CI lower bound > 0, with equivalence and validity 100%: session-shape dependent; both numbers reported
HCL.secondary_contrast: X+V vs X+HCL+V reported the same way (not gating)

V.primary_metric: k=1 paired T_oracle(X) - T_oracle(X+V), per task
V.DELETED: median >= 1 ms AND CI lower bound > 0 AND the V control passes
V.NOT_MATERIAL: CI includes 0 AND upper bound < 1 ms
V.extension_preregistered: if neither rule applies, the work-level rule decides: if the paired admission_v work span (summed over the task's in-T tools/call requests, X - X+V) has a CI upper bound < 1 ms, the knob cannot save >= 1 ms of serial wall clock: NOT_MATERIAL (work-level); otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (component stays UNTESTED)

E2_recompute.best_arm: per task, the arm with the lowest median k=1 T_oracle among arms whose main trials are 100% valid and verified; ties broken in the order X, X+V, X+HCL, X+HCL+V
E2_recompute.untested_share: sum of the mean ms of components whose verdict is UNTESTED, divided by the mean T_oracle of the best arm's valid trials (R2-10 decomposition rule)

verdicts.carried_from_R2-10: observation IRREDUCIBLE, runner UNTESTED, resolution UNTESTED, reveal OWNER_DECISION, dispatch IRREDUCIBLE, post_action_sleep DELETED, settle IRREDUCIBLE, result UNTESTED, effect_lag IRREDUCIBLE, verification_read IRREDUCIBLE, observation_transport IRREDUCIBLE (R2-10 reading)
verdicts.action_transport_split: client_validate: HCL DELETED -> residual UNTESTED (R2-10 rule for the compiled-validator residual); HCL OWNER_DECISION -> OWNER_DECISION; HCL KILL -> IRREDUCIBLE (KILL; removing client validation altogether changes the library contract and is not tested). admission_v: V DELETED -> residual UNTESTED; NOT_MATERIAL -> IRREDUCIBLE (KILL, tested, immaterial); INCONCLUSIVE -> UNTESTED. drv_bookkeep_serialize, drv_write: IRREDUCIBLE (N-02, cited). Every other sub-span (client_build, client_write_pipe, drv_parse, the rest of drv_admission and drv_inner_pre, drv_inner_post, client_pipe_read_parse, client_result_model, client_return): UNTESTED.
verdicts.readings: PRIMARY (R2-10 reading, the taxonomy of the 4.1% / 7.5% baseline): observation_transport IRREDUCIBLE as R2-10 classified it, action_transport split as above. CONSERVATIVE (N-02 reading, reported): observation_transport split with the same sub-span verdicts.

E2_recompute.target: untested share < 5% for both tasks (primary reading)
E2_recompute.work_vs_wall: work deleted (component and sub-span mean differences, e.g. client_validate, admission_v) reported separately from wall clock saved (paired T differences)

controls.HC_equivalence_online: every HCL-arm call is re-validated after the trial (outside T) with the library path; verdict and message compared; required 100% agreement
controls.HC_equivalence_offline: hc_control.py (jev-use venv, under hostless, no display, no Driver): output schemas and real results from the measured a1/a2 HCL corpus (rounds 0 and 12). Per tool with an output schema used in a session (list_windows, set_agent_cursor_motion, get_agent_cursor_state, get_window_state, set_value, click): candidate mutants generated deterministically from the real results in corpus order (strategies in a fixed order: add_unknown_property, drop_required per present required key, wrong_type per present simply-typed property, required_to_null per present required key, enum_violation per present enum property, nested_wrong_type per present object property); the first 10 distinct mutants per tool that the library path rejects form the invalid corpus (N-02 selection rule). PASS iff the lazy HCL path rejects all 10 per tool with the same message, and accepts every real result the library accepts. CallToolResult requires an object structuredContent, so non-object roots cannot be injected (N-02 deviation 4).
controls.V_cache: 5 vctl rows in X+V (and 5 in X for comparison), one Driver session each: tools/list A; a modern-era call to an unknown tool; a measured checkbox task; tools/list B (re-list mid-session); the unknown-tool call again; a modern-era and a legacy call to a known tool. PASS iff in every X+V row the unknown tool is refused before and after the re-list with the same error class as X, the known tool is admitted in both eras, the re-listed inventory is identical, and the task verifies. SOURCE (invalidation scope): SdkAdapter.tools_list is a plain Value loaded once in SdkAdapter::load and never mutated (no interior mutability; only &self accessors); tools/list is answered from that same Value; tools_list_ref borrows it. The cache's invalidation scope is the process lifetime, which equals the inventory's lifetime, so admission always validates against the list tools/list serves.
controls.focus_steal: decoy kind: the X focus is moved to a decoy window ~100 ms after the app's state change (xprobe.Decoy, verbatim from N-01R); 5 per task per arm (blocks cd1, cd2, SHARED); PASS iff restored in every row
controls.default_off_smoke: blocks csn3 (N3) and csr (R), arm D: no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_*, no phase trace file, default cursor motion; PASS iff tools/list canonical sha256 identical between N3 and R, native checkbox 5/5 and text 5/5 verified on both, identical receipt shapes, trace files empty
controls.part_b_route: every Part B row must show receipt route accessibility, delivery mode foreground, 'path=ax_fg' in the receipt text and an atspi_action/do_action_replied mark; any global_input (or other route) row is REFUSED from analysis and counted
controls.part_b_fixture_smoke: block bs1: fixture_axfg.py with CUA_N03_AXFG unset shows exactly the repository fixture's element labels/roles and state keys (2 rows)
controls.part_b_positive_control: block bd1: 30 ms app-side delay (CUA_N03_AXFG_APPLY_DELAY_MS=30), arms S0U and BU, 5 rounds x 2 element types; PASS (oracle discriminates) iff S0U is NOT visible at return in 10/10. BU is reported. Block bd2: S0 at default with the 30 ms delay, 5 x 2, reported (expected visible: the 800 ms observation covers the delay).

part_b.fixture: fixture_axfg.py: env-gated (CUA_N03_AXFG=1), default-off wrapper of the repository fixture adding a 60 px GtkScrolledWindow whose content is a 1200 px spacer, then check box 'Hidden agree' and push button 'Hidden save' (scrolled out of view: Visible but not Showing). Handlers record axfg_agreed / axfg_clicks and axfg_effect_mono_ns (the app's CLOCK_MONOTONIC in the signal handler at the model change), then publish the state file.

families.D_primary: default configuration: B (default 50 ms post-DoAction sleep) vs S0 (CUA_DRIVER_EXP_NATIVE_POST_ACTION_SLEEP_MS=0); 20 AB/BA pairs per element type (check box, button); block b1, 80 trials, fresh Driver + fixture per trial, EXCLUSIVE
families.U_secondary: the same with the documented host setting CUA_DRIVER_WINDOW_CHANGE_TIMEOUT_MS=0 in both arms (BU vs S0U): the post-DoAction sleep is then the only post-action wait (the truly unguarded shape); block bu1, 80 trials, EXCLUSIVE

metrics.visible_at_return: t_effect <= t_return, where t_effect is the app's handler stamp axfg_effect_mono_ns as read from the state file by the 2 ms sampler and t_return is the click call's caller-side return (same host CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
metrics.strict_sampler: the first sample starting at/after t_return shows the expected state (R2-09 metric), reported
metrics.publication_lag_rule: a row with visible_at_return true and strict_sampler false is classified publication_lag (the app changed its model before return; its file write lagged). It counts as visible for the gate only through the gate's own margin condition (margin >= 1 ms). No other exception exists.
metrics.T: T_oracle as Part A (first observation send -> first matching sample at/after return); wall clock saved B - S0 reported per element type with the paired bootstrap

part_b.gate_R2-09_rule: per family and element type: S0 (resp. S0U) is DELETED on ax_fg iff visible_at_return is 20/20 and the minimum margin is >= 1 ms; otherwise the sleep is IRREDUCIBLE on ax_fg (KILL S0 there). The terminal E1 verdict for the R2-09 ax_fg route is family D's (the shipped default); family U's verdict is reported as the scoped verdict for hosts that set CUA_DRIVER_WINDOW_CHANGE_TIMEOUT_MS=0. A family whose positive control fails (U: S0U visible in any bd1 row) is NOT_RUN-equivalent (oracle not shown to discriminate) and gets no DELETED verdict.

failure_handling: every trial is kept and stays in its denominators. A block that fails before any trial starts (session start: private DISPLAY or AT-SPI bus not available) is kept in raw and re-run under a new label (-rN); a block that started trials is never re-run.
invariants: no Driver change; every knob and fixture variant env-gated and default-off (CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ADMISSION_TOOLS_CACHE, CUA_DRIVER_EXP_NATIVE_POST_ACTION_SLEEP_MS, CUA_N03_AXFG, CUA_N03_AXFG_APPLY_DELAY_MS; CUA_DRIVER_WINDOW_CHANGE_TIMEOUT_MS is a documented host setting); no new service; events are never the oracle (the target-owned state file is); receipts never decide success
claim_boundary: GTK3 AT-SPI on X11 (private Xvfb), binary N3 only, scripted, no provider. Native live-provider arms stay BLOCKED (budget). Nothing is ratioed against R2-10's binary.
